body:
I tried and smoked 1 bowl of an even mix of the 2 herbs.  They lasted for about 4 hours for me.  I felt like running a marathon race.  It was an invigorating experience.  The taste was not bad either.  The smoke was a little hot.  It probably have been better from a water pipe.
